gui.auditHint: Records mutations of tasks, settings, templates, profiles, workspaces, secrets, imports and history cleanup. Details are masked (secrets replaced with {redacted}).

gui.matrixSelectHint: Select at least one workspace — the clone preview will appear here.

gui.matrixWillCreate: Will create {count, plural, one {# clone} other {# clones}}:
gui.mcpFilterHint: key=value is compared to the payload field; otherwise the filter is treated as regex/substring. Events arrive via RPC emit_event.
gui.metricsTotalsTitle: Total metrics across all tasks (including archived metric records)
gui.modelHint: Empty — the default OpenCode model. Otherwise the --model flag is passed.

gui.oneShotDelayHint: Or a delay in seconds from the “Create task” click:

gui.openDashboardTitle: Open the local web dashboard (actual server port)
gui.outsideWindowLabel: Outside the window or on a disallowed day
gui.postflightHint: E.g. git push or npm run build. Runs in the task's working directory even on failure of the main task.
gui.preflightHint: E.g. git pull or npm install. Runs in the task's working directory. A non-zero exit cancels the run (Pre-flight script failed).
gui.priorityHint: If several tasks are ready at once, the highest-priority task starts first.
gui.profile.deleteConfirm: Delete profile "{name}" along with its DB, settings and logs?
gui.profile.namePrompt: New profile name (latin letters, digits, - and _)

gui.profileEnvLockedTitle: The profile is set via the OPENCODE_SCHEDULER_PROFILE environment variable — switching in the GUI is unavailable
gui.profilesHint: Each profile has its own DB, settings, logs and dashboard port. Restart OpenCode after switching.
gui.profilesTitle: Profiles: separate DBs, settings and dashboard port
gui.promptTemplates.codeHygienePrompt: Audit code hygiene: find unused imports, unused variables, extra dependencies and suggest fixes.
gui.promptTemplates.morningDigestPrompt: Put together the morning digest: what changed overnight, any failed builds, what needs attention today.
gui.promptTemplates.nightWatchPrompt: Run nightly checks: run the tests, record failures and write a short repo status report.
gui.qualityGateHint: Runs after the AI responds successfully. Non-zero exit = task failure.
gui.quietHoursHint: In quiet hours, success and partial are suppressed; errors and timeouts are sent.
gui.retryHint: Retry on network error, timeout, 5xx and 429 (exponential backoff).
gui.saveAsTemplateTitle: Save current form settings as a template
gui.secretsEmpty: No secrets. Values are stored encrypted in secrets.json.
gui.secretsUsage: Use the {secretRef} reference in tasks — the value is injected from the vault at run time and masked in logs.

gui.sessionMaxRunsLabel: How many runs a session survives (sessionMaxRuns, optional)
gui.timezoneHint: Another zone — the task wakes every minute, cron is checked in that zone.

gui.toolLimitsDenied: On conflict, denied wins. An empty allowedTools is forbidden.
gui.toolLimitsNote: ⚠ Metadata-only: opencode 2.2.3 has no allow/deny flags — limits are recorded in logs and history.
gui.validation.dependsOnSelf: A task cannot depend on itself.
gui.validation.gitPollInvalid: Git poll interval — a whole number of seconds of at least 5.
gui.validation.gitWorkspaceRequired: For a git trigger, pick a workspace or set a working directory.
gui.validation.matrixConcurrencyInvalid: Matrix concurrency — a positive whole number.
gui.validation.matrixWorkspacesRequired: Select at least one workspace for the matrix.
gui.validation.priorityInvalid: Priority — a whole number from 0 to 10.
gui.validation.retryDelayInvalid: Retry delay — a whole number of seconds ≥ 0.
gui.validation.runAtRequired: Specify a run time or a delay.
gui.validation.sessionMaxRunsInvalid: Session run limit — a positive whole number.

gui.validation.windowPairRequired: The run window is set only as a from/to pair.
gui.watchFileLabel: Path of the file to watch

gui.watchGlobsLabel: Glob patterns (one per line, empty — any change)
gui.webhookPostHint: POST with JSON {payload} — compatible with Discord and Slack.
gui.windowEndTitle: Window end (may be earlier than the start)

gui.workingDirectoryHint: The task runs opencode run in this folder — MCP servers from opencode.json are picked up here.
gui.workspace.deleteConfirm: Delete workspace "{name}"? Tasks are kept, the binding is cleared.
gui.workspace.envFilePrompt: Path to the workspace .env file (optional, empty — none)

Workspace env variables, one per line KEY=VALUE

gui.workspaceEmpty: No workspaces added. A task without a workspace uses the project working directory.
